Renewal of mining lease of M/s Mysore
Minerals Ltd.
750. SHRI JANARDHANA
POOJARY: Will the Minister of COAL
AND MINES be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the
Government of Karnataka has
recommended for renewal of mining lease
in favour of M/s Mysore Minerals Ltd., in
respect of reserve forest land for mining
manganese in Shimoga, Kolar, Kanakpura
areas; and
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
Centre's reaction thereto?
Proposal  for  renewal  of  lease  of
M/s Bellary Mining Corporation
751. SHRI JANARDHANA
POOJARY: Will the Minister of COAL
AND MINES be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the
Government of Karnataka has sent a
proposal for renewing the mining lease
No. 1586 for a period of 10 years in favour
of M/s Bellary Mining Corporation over an
area of 15.80 ha. in Hulakundi Village,
District Bellary, Karnataka, for extraction
of Iron ore; and
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
Centre's reaction thereto?
Approval for leasing mining to
Kudremukh Iron Ore Company Ltd.
752. SHRI JANARDHANA
POOJARY: Will the Minister of COAL
AND MINES be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Kudremukh
Iron Ore Company Ltd. (KIOCL) has
sought Central Government's approval for
leasing mines in various States, if so, the
details thereof; and
(b) by when KIOCL is expected to
receive the centre's approval in this regard?
Coal requirement in the country
†753. DR. ABRAR AHMED: Will the
Minister of COAL AND MINES be
pleased to state:
(a) the stock of coal to meet the domestic
and industrial requirements of the country;
and
(b) the effective steps being taken by
Government to maintain availability as well
as the balance between the demand and
supply of coal?

Approval for Greenfield Projects
by IL
754. SHRI R.S. GAVAI: Will the
Minister of COAL AND MINES be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is fact that Coal India Ltd.
has approved six large Greenfield Projects
for future, keeping in mind assured offtake
of power grade coal by SEB's and NTPC;
(b) if so, the details of the projects
cleared;
(c) whether these projects will be allotted
to private sector;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) if not, the reasons therefor?
Payment of DA to officers of CIL
during their foreign visits
†755. SHRI VIJAY SINGH YADAV:
Will the Minister of COAL AND MINES
be pleased to state:
(a) whether the payment of DA to
officers of Coal India Ltd. and its
subsidiaries is not made in accordance with
the guidelines  of the Government of India
during their foreign visits;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor;
(c) the details of the foreign visits
undertaken by officers of Coal India Ltd.
and its subsidiaries during the last three
years;
(d) whether it is a fact that during the
period of training false payment of DA was
made; and
(e) if so, the details of the action taken
against the officers responsible for the
same?
Visit of Indian  industry delegation to
the USA
756. DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
SHRI K. NATWAR SINGH:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a first ever
Indian industry delegation with focus on
the defence sector visited the US in the
month of May-June, 2002 to strengthen
bilateral defence-industrial ties and seek new
opportunities for mutually beneficial
business;
(b) if so, the main topics discussed
during the visits;
(c) whether any concrete agreements
have been reached between India and the
US on defence ties; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Weapons deal with the United
States
757. SHRI K. NATWAR SINGH: Will
the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether India has signed the first
major weapons deal with the United States
in more than three decades;
(b) if so, what are the total defence deals
signed between the two countries;
(c) whether this deal was signed before
the Chief Army Staff visit USA;
(d) if so, to what extent this defence deal
between the two countries have helped the
capability of Indian army?
